title: Cone 10 Reduction Firing for Color and Effect
evidence_sentence: The workshop page instructs potters to bring bisque-fired pieces and learn to load and fire a gas kiln.
evidence_quote: Bring 10-20 small/medium bisque-fired pieces of cone 9-10 clay and learn to load and fire a gas kiln.
bring: 10-20 small/medium bisque-fired pieces of cone 9-10 clay
how_to_join: Sign up via Folk School website
summary: A week-long workshop (May 31–June 6, 2026) at the John C Campbell Folk School teaching gas reduction firing to intermediate and advanced potters. Bring bisque-fired cone 9–10 pieces, and combine firing with wheel-throwing skill-building. Meals and lodging arranged by the Folk School.
